title: Explanation
summary: Make a technical product, paper, or idea legible to people who are not in the field.
body:
This is the public half of the work: the bridge from non-tech to tech. A team brings the thing they built. Ryan’s job, if he takes it, is to make it understandable without sanding off the part that is actually true.

title: Building
summary: Applied software collaborations: research tools, education products, and interfaces in front of them.
body:
The public code is the evidence for this lane: quant research, education software, and small product interfaces. A collaboration starts from the inquiry form, not from a packaged price.
